title: A small explained share
hook: Two stated cases: explore the difference between correlation and explained variation.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the difference between correlation and explained variation affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Percent, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the difference between correlation and explained variation in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
